title: abhigyanpatwari/GitNexus: map a codebase into a local knowledge graph
friendlyTitle: GitNexus draws a map of your code project
summary: GitNexus analyzes a repository or ZIP into an interactive knowledge graph and provides a Graph RAG agent for exploring relationships in the code. Its browser-based approach is designed to work without a separate server and supports repositories from major hosting services or local files.
friendlySummary: GitNexus turns a software repository into a visual map and lets an AI agent answer questions about how the code is connected.
whyItMatters: Developers can use it to orient themselves in an unfamiliar project, trace dependencies and give coding agents structural context before making changes. For private code, verify the selected model path and data-handling settings even when analysis runs locally.
friendlyWhyItMatters: It can help you understand a large or unfamiliar project faster. Check privacy settings before connecting a model to private code.
